mainEntity.name: What documents or information should I prepare before starting pre-construction planning?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before starting pre-construction planning, gathering certain documents and information can significantly streamline the process. This includes property surveys, existing architectural plans, any specific homeowner's association guidelines, and a clear understanding of your desired budget and project goals. Having a preliminary idea of your aesthetic preferences and functional needs will also help our team accurately translate your vision into a buildable plan and identify potential design or material trade-offs early on.
acceptedAnswer.description: Prepare property surveys, existing plans, HOA rules, budget, and project goals before pre-construction planning to help define your vision.
